scenarios.title: Legacy behavior remains opt-in unchanged
scenarios.given: the existing proxy is started without the gateway flag
scenarios.when: the retained wrapper and compression regression corpus runs
scenarios.then: outputs and effective defaults match the qualified legacy baseline

scenarios.title: Conflicting pure-profile settings fail early
scenarios.given: gateway mode and memory or output shaping are explicitly enabled together
scenarios.when: the real CLI parses and validates configuration
scenarios.then: startup fails before reading any credential or opening an upstream connection

scenarios.title: Effective configuration is redacted
scenarios.given: a gateway configuration references client and provider secrets
scenarios.when: the operator requests effective configuration
scenarios.then: the output shows references and policy values but no secret values

scenarios.title: Validation has no auth side effects
scenarios.given: credential readers and network calls are instrumented as forbidden
scenarios.when: the real CLI runs check-config on a valid proposal config
scenarios.then: validation succeeds with zero credential reads and zero network calls

scenarios.title: Unsupported runtime topology fails closed
scenarios.given: a Rust-only launch lacks gateway enforcement qualification
scenarios.when: the operator requests managed gateway mode
scenarios.then: startup refuses instead of using a legacy bypass route

scenarios.title: Strict native bodies preserve exact bytes
scenarios.given: each advertised native protocol has a fixture with whitespace Unicode and opaque fields
scenarios.when: the client sends the fixture through a real gateway socket
scenarios.then: upstream entity bytes equal the original bytes and the mutation ledger is empty

scenarios.title: All independent content transforms stay off
scenarios.given: compression CCR memory learning prefix rewriting effort shaping and cache injection are instrumented
scenarios.when: a pure gateway serves a tool-free and a tool-bearing request on every generation route
scenarios.then: none of those transforms or model warmups is called and no tool is injected

scenarios.title: Native tool and signed content survives
scenarios.given: native history includes signed thinking parallel tool IDs and ordered tool results
scenarios.when: the gateway forwards it without alias rewriting
scenarios.then: all opaque blocks signatures IDs and ordering reach upstream unchanged

scenarios.title: Alias rewriting is declared rather than byte-faithful
scenarios.given: an authorized public model alias differs from the upstream model ID
scenarios.when: a routed-native request is dispatched
scenarios.then: only declared routing fields differ and diagnostics identify routed-native not strict-native

scenarios.title: No inherited process setting re-enables optimization
scenarios.given: the parent shell enables every legacy optimization environment switch
scenarios.when: pure gateway configuration is validated and started
scenarios.then: conflicting explicit settings are rejected or isolated by the documented precedence without any hidden mutation

scenarios.title: Invalid client key causes no upstream request
scenarios.given: the mock upstream and broker have zero recorded calls
scenarios.when: an SDK sends a missing or incorrect Headroom client key
scenarios.then: the gateway returns the ingress auth error and both call counts remain zero

scenarios.title: Loopback still requires authorization
scenarios.given: Headroom is listening only on loopback with a managed provider identity
scenarios.when: an unauthenticated local process requests generation
scenarios.then: the request is rejected and the provider identity is never resolved

scenarios.title: Conflicting auth headers are rejected
scenarios.given: a request contains different values in supported local credential header slots
scenarios.when: it reaches the native or translated route
scenarios.then: the gateway rejects ambiguity without forwarding either value

scenarios.title: Model visibility is principal scoped
scenarios.given: two principals are granted disjoint routes and accounts
scenarios.when: each principal lists models and requests the other principal's model
scenarios.then: only permitted models are listed and forbidden access never reaches upstream

scenarios.title: Inference keys cannot administer identities
scenarios.given: a valid client key has inference and models scopes only
scenarios.when: the client calls account management or runtime environment mutation
scenarios.then: the control action is denied and effective configuration remains unchanged

scenarios.title: Local client key never reaches upstream
scenarios.given: the downstream key and upstream provider secret are distinct sentinels
scenarios.when: a valid managed request succeeds for each ingress protocol
scenarios.then: only the selected provider credential is present upstream and no internal auth header is forwarded

scenarios.title: Client-selected upstream cannot receive managed secrets
scenarios.given: a caller supplies a base-URL override to an attacker-controlled fixture
scenarios.when: the request would otherwise use an operator credential
scenarios.then: the request is rejected before any connection and no credential is resolved for that destination

scenarios.title: Another trusted provider is still the wrong audience
scenarios.given: two provider origins are operator configured but one credential belongs only to the first
scenarios.when: routing attempts to send that credential to the second or to a different port or project path
scenarios.then: the credential-specific audience check denies egress

scenarios.title: Redirect and DNS rebinding cannot move a secret
scenarios.given: an authorized destination redirects or resolves to a forbidden address after validation
scenarios.when: the gateway handles the response or connection attempt
scenarios.then: it neither follows with credentials nor connects to a disallowed rebound address

scenarios.title: TLS failures do not enable insecure fallback
scenarios.given: the provider fixture presents an invalid certificate
scenarios.when: a request attempts credentialed HTTPS
scenarios.then: verification fails and no retry downgrades TLS or sends the token elsewhere

scenarios.title: Refresh is single-flight across tasks and workers
scenarios.given: many concurrent requests share an expiring refreshable account
scenarios.when: all acquire a lease at the refresh boundary
scenarios.then: one refresh generation is published and waiters use a consistent token without stale writes

scenarios.title: Late refresh cannot overwrite a new generation
scenarios.given: refresh A is delayed while an authorized refresh B or re-login publishes a newer credential
scenarios.when: A later finishes with an older token or invalid-grant error
scenarios.then: generation comparison prevents overwriting or revoking the newer credential

scenarios.title: Borrowed caches are read-only
scenarios.given: a native client's auth store is borrowed and the native client owns refresh
scenarios.when: Headroom encounters an expired or rotating token
scenarios.then: it delegates through the admitted interface or reports reauth-required without writing the native store

scenarios.title: Revocation does not trigger paid fallback
scenarios.given: an account is revoked and a separate billable API key exists locally but is not granted
scenarios.when: a client retries a request
scenarios.then: the gateway reports the configured unavailable state and never discovers or charges the other key

scenarios.title: SDK identity refresh survives long uptime
scenarios.given: a cloud SDK source issues short-lived credentials and the test clock crosses expiry
scenarios.when: requests continue before and after refresh
scenarios.then: new requests use valid refreshed credentials with no unsigned request or expired-token reuse

scenarios.title: Model aliases are unique
scenarios.given: two routes claim the same caller-visible model identifier
scenarios.when: configuration validation runs
scenarios.then: it fails with a collision diagnostic before startup

scenarios.title: Catalog is entitlement aware
scenarios.given: an account lacks permission for one configured model
scenarios.when: the authenticated client lists models and requests that model
scenarios.then: unavailable capability is not advertised as usable and generation is denied before paid work

scenarios.title: Catalog refresh is bounded and truthful
scenarios.given: an upstream model-list request fails and cached metadata exists
scenarios.when: a client requests model discovery
scenarios.then: the policy serves explicitly stale allowed metadata or an unavailable error without claiming fresh health

scenarios.title: Capability rejection precedes credential acquisition
scenarios.given: the selected model cannot represent the requested hosted tool or modality
scenarios.when: the gateway validates a translated request
scenarios.then: it returns unsupported-capability with zero credential refreshes and zero upstream generations

scenarios.title: Route and model metadata stay consistent
scenarios.given: an alias maps to a permitted upstream model and a fixed capability snapshot
scenarios.when: the request completes while the catalog refreshes
scenarios.then: response metadata and usage refer to the selected route snapshot rather than a new model

scenarios.title: Tool calls preserve execution semantics
scenarios.given: supported source and target protocols carry two parallel calls and later tool results
scenarios.when: the request response and streamed events cross the translation boundary
scenarios.then: tool names call IDs argument bytes ordering and result association match the approved semantic oracle

scenarios.title: Image and text parts remain ordered
scenarios.given: a supported translation includes text and inline image parts with validated MIME and size
scenarios.when: the adapter constructs the upstream request and returns output
scenarios.then: part order image bytes and supported detail fields survive without implicit remote fetching

scenarios.title: Opaque signed reasoning is rejected when unmappable
scenarios.given: a translated request contains provider-signed reasoning unavailable in the target protocol
scenarios.when: the adapter performs capability validation
scenarios.then: it rejects the request instead of rewriting dropping or reinterpreting the signed block

scenarios.title: Unknown translation fields do not disappear
scenarios.given: a request supplies an extension strict schema or stop feature without a declared mapping
scenarios.when: the adapter processes the request
scenarios.then: it returns a specific unsupported-field or capability error rather than a success with lost semantics

scenarios.title: Finish usage and error mapping is honest
scenarios.given: fixtures cover stop length tool-use refusal provider failure and missing usage
scenarios.when: each qualified translation direction runs
scenarios.then: finish and error semantics match the ingress contract and missing usage is null or omitted rather than invented

scenarios.title: Streaming is incremental rather than buffered
scenarios.given: the upstream sends one complete event then blocks until the client observes it
scenarios.when: the client requests a streamed native response
scenarios.then: the first event reaches the client before upstream completion and releases the fixture barrier

scenarios.title: Fragmentation preserves Unicode and tool arguments
scenarios.given: the fixture splits UTF-8 bytes JSON argument fragments and SSE lines at every relevant boundary
scenarios.when: the stream passes through native and qualified translated routes
scenarios.then: the reassembled semantic result is correct with bounded buffering and no malformed event

scenarios.title: Truncated streams never masquerade as success
scenarios.given: the upstream disconnects after partial output before its protocol terminal condition
scenarios.when: the gateway finishes the downstream transport
scenarios.then: the client observes an error or failed termination and no synthetic successful completion

scenarios.title: Cancellation releases upstream resources
scenarios.given: a client disconnects during a long generation
scenarios.when: the gateway observes cancellation
scenarios.then: upstream work is cancelled where supported and tasks sockets leases and budget reservations are released within the configured bound

scenarios.title: Heartbeat-only and stalled-line streams are bounded
scenarios.given: the upstream emits only keepalives or stalls mid-line
scenarios.when: the configured absolute or idle deadline elapses
scenarios.then: a timer terminates the request independently of further frame arrival and it is not recorded as successful content

scenarios.title: Response IDs cannot cross principals
scenarios.given: principal A creates a stored response while B is denied its route
scenarios.when: B attempts read continue cancel or delete using A's response identifier
scenarios.then: the gateway hides the resource and makes no provider request on A's identity

scenarios.title: Stateful continuation remains on its creating account
scenarios.given: a response or socket belongs to account A and A becomes unavailable while B is healthy
scenarios.when: the client sends a continuation with opaque provider state
scenarios.then: the gateway does not migrate to B and returns the declared unavailable result

scenarios.title: WebSocket budget is checked every turn
scenarios.given: a socket was authorized before its first turn exhausted the budget
scenarios.when: the client sends a later response.create on the same socket
scenarios.then: the later generation is rejected before forwarding while metrics preserve budget-exceeded origin

scenarios.title: WebSocket acceptance is never replayed on reconnect
scenarios.given: an upstream accepted a frame and the socket fails before an unambiguous terminal result
scenarios.when: the client or gateway reconnects
scenarios.then: the gateway does not silently resubmit the accepted operation or change account

scenarios.title: Subpaths and upgrades cannot bypass policy
scenarios.given: the route inventory includes response subpaths live routes batch endpoints and generic passthrough
scenarios.when: an unauthorized client exercises every listed path and upgrade variant
scenarios.then: each path is denied or explicitly unsupported with zero credentialed egress

scenarios.title: Safe pre-acceptance retries stay within policy
scenarios.given: the adapter proves a connection failed before any request was accepted and the route allows two attempts
scenarios.when: the first attempt fails and the second succeeds
scenarios.then: exactly two attempts occur within one deadline and the logical request is recorded once

scenarios.title: Ambiguous acceptance prevents automatic replay
scenarios.given: the request body was sent but the connection fails before a response
scenarios.when: retry evaluation runs
scenarios.then: the gateway returns an ambiguous-upstream failure without trying another account by default

scenarios.title: Exposed output prevents account switching
scenarios.given: a stream has emitted text or a hosted-tool event
scenarios.when: the upstream later returns overload or quota failure
scenarios.then: the gateway reports the failure without replaying content or switching identities

scenarios.title: Quota cooling does not silently change billing
scenarios.given: a pool account hits a quota and another project paid plan or owner is available but not permitted
scenarios.when: selection evaluates alternatives
scenarios.then: only explicitly granted equivalent accounts can be selected and no hidden billing boundary is crossed

scenarios.title: Retry storms have hard bounds
scenarios.given: all allowed accounts are overloaded and Retry-After varies
scenarios.when: many clients request generations
scenarios.then: attempt count queue length cooldown sleep and total request deadline remain bounded with no busy loop

scenarios.title: Concurrent budget reservations prevent overspend admission
scenarios.given: multiple requests race for a budget that can admit only one reserved maximum
scenarios.when: they arrive on different routes or workers
scenarios.then: atomic admission allows only the safe subset and denied requests never reach upstream

scenarios.title: Retry accounting retains all known charged attempts
scenarios.given: a request makes permitted attempts with known and unknown upstream usage
scenarios.when: the request succeeds fails or is cancelled
scenarios.then: known charged usage is retained and unknown usage is explicitly flagged without double-counting a logical response

scenarios.title: Concurrency permits are released on every exit
scenarios.given: parse errors auth failures timeouts cancellation and upstream failures are injected
scenarios.when: each request exits its control path
scenarios.then: all permits and reservations return to the correct owner exactly once

scenarios.title: Queue admission is bounded and tenant scoped
scenarios.given: one caller fills its concurrency and waiting limits
scenarios.when: another caller submits work and the first adds more requests
scenarios.then: the noisy caller receives bounded backpressure without consuming the other caller's allocation

scenarios.title: Subscription allowance is not fabricated token billing
scenarios.given: a native adapter exposes request credits but not token price or complete usage
scenarios.when: metrics and budget policy evaluate the result
scenarios.then: allowance units remain distinct from currency and tokens and unavailable costs are never reported as zero-cost proof

scenarios.title: Secrets never appear in diagnostics
scenarios.given: distinct sentinels occupy client keys upstream tokens refresh tokens and query credentials
scenarios.when: success refresh failure and startup diagnostics are collected
scenarios.then: logs metrics traces crash summaries and admin JSON contain none of those sentinels

scenarios.title: Pure gateway sends no beacon or prompt telemetry
scenarios.given: the parent environment enables legacy telemetry and an egress recorder is active
scenarios.when: the gateway starts serves requests and shuts down
scenarios.then: only explicitly configured identity and inference traffic occurs and no beacon or payload export is made

scenarios.title: Metric labels remain bounded
scenarios.given: clients send arbitrary model names session IDs headers and error text
scenarios.when: the gateway rejects or serves requests while emitting metrics
scenarios.then: label cardinality follows configured bounded categories and excludes raw caller values

scenarios.title: Stateless means no filesystem writes
scenarios.given: the gateway and credential adapters run under a read-only or instrumented filesystem
scenarios.when: requests discovery refresh and shutdown occur
scenarios.then: no write is attempted and incompatible stateful sources are rejected before serving

scenarios.title: Provider error redaction is a documented fidelity exception
scenarios.given: an upstream error fixture reflects a brokered secret in its body or headers
scenarios.when: the gateway returns the error to an authenticated client
scenarios.then: the secret is redacted while safe status code and diagnostic meaning remain available

scenarios.title: Input limits apply before expansion and parsing
scenarios.given: requests contain oversized compressed bodies invalid UTF-8 duplicate identity-critical JSON keys or path traversal
scenarios.when: each input hits the actual server parser
scenarios.then: the request is rejected with bounded memory and zero upstream generations

scenarios.title: Cloud identity metadata is a narrow exception
scenarios.given: the cloud SDK needs its documented metadata identity endpoint but a caller asks inference to that endpoint
scenarios.when: both paths are exercised
scenarios.then: only the explicitly configured SDK identity flow may use it and arbitrary inference SSRF is rejected

scenarios.title: Local browser requests do not inherit account authority
scenarios.given: a web page sends requests with an untrusted Origin or Host including a WebSocket upgrade
scenarios.when: the loopback gateway receives the traffic
scenarios.then: origin host and client-key checks prevent account use even on localhost

scenarios.title: Forwarded address headers cannot bypass auth
scenarios.given: a remote client sends forged forwarded-for and forwarded-proto headers
scenarios.when: the gateway receives them without a configured trusted reverse proxy
scenarios.then: it ignores the claimed identity and enforces the normal auth and TLS policy

scenarios.title: Remote media URLs cannot trigger hidden SSRF
scenarios.given: a translated request references a private or redirected image URL
scenarios.when: the adapter evaluates multimodal input
scenarios.then: it passes a supported reference without fetching or rejects it and never performs an unauthorized fetch

scenarios.title: Configuration reload is atomic
scenarios.given: an in-flight request uses snapshot A and proposed snapshot B is malformed or changes a route
scenarios.when: reload is attempted while requests continue
scenarios.then: invalid B leaves A active and valid B affects only newly admitted work except explicit revocation

scenarios.title: Revocation reaches queued and active requests
scenarios.given: an operator disables an account with queued and in-flight work
scenarios.when: the new revocation generation is published
scenarios.then: queued work is denied immediately and active work follows the documented cancellation policy with safe cleanup

scenarios.title: Shutdown does not kill unrelated proxies
scenarios.given: an existing Headroom or unrelated listener was not started by this process
scenarios.when: a wrapper or gateway session stops
scenarios.then: only owned child processes are signalled and unrelated listeners remain alive

scenarios.title: Listener reuse verifies identity and configuration
scenarios.given: the configured port contains a different service or incompatible Headroom profile
scenarios.when: startup attempts reuse
scenarios.then: it rejects the listener rather than treating any HTTP 200 as readiness

scenarios.title: Readiness has no login or billing side effect
scenarios.given: the gateway has a configured but expired or unavailable account
scenarios.when: liveness readiness and provider diagnostics are queried
scenarios.then: liveness stays minimal readiness reports local state and only an explicitly authorized diagnostic may resolve or probe the provider

scenarios.title: Desktop credential stores are qualified on real platforms
scenarios.given: macOS Windows and Linux desktop sources are separately in the advertised matrix
scenarios.when: each real platform executes discovery denial locking rotation and logout tests
scenarios.then: support is marked only for the tested source and platform and mock success is not substituted

scenarios.title: Cloud signing and project boundaries use final payload
scenarios.given: a Bedrock or Vertex route has explicit region project and identity constraints
scenarios.when: a native or translated body is prepared and authorized
scenarios.then: authentication or signing uses final bytes and forbidden region project or endpoint variants are rejected

scenarios.title: Source precedence respects managed enterprise requirements
scenarios.given: multiple valid credential sources and an enforced account or workspace policy exist
scenarios.when: the broker selects an account
scenarios.then: only the configured allowed source is used and mismatched cached native credentials are not silently imported

scenarios.title: Stateless identity sources cannot persist refresh
scenarios.given: a selected SDK or native source requires a disk cache write to refresh
scenarios.when: the operator enables stateless gateway mode
scenarios.then: startup or lease acquisition rejects the incompatible source without creating a writable fallback

scenarios.title: Locked keychain does not fall back to plaintext
scenarios.given: a configured OS secret store is locked denied or unavailable
scenarios.when: the broker attempts an admitted source read
scenarios.then: it returns a bounded actionable status and does not scan alternative credential files

scenarios.title: Real SDKs exercise their own serializers and stream parsers
scenarios.given: pinned OpenAI Python and JavaScript Anthropic and Gemini clients target the gateway
scenarios.when: non-stream stream tool and error fixtures run through their actual APIs
scenarios.then: each claimed SDK and version passes without monkeypatching its HTTP client internals

scenarios.title: Existing wrapper behavior is preserved
scenarios.given: legacy wrapper commands and installed harness fixtures use their existing profiles
scenarios.when: prepare-only assertions and actual traffic tests run separately
scenarios.then: environment setup proxy ownership and provider behavior remain compatible and prepare-only is not labelled full E2E

scenarios.title: Python and qualified Rust-front topology agree
scenarios.given: identical auth egress streaming and pure fixtures run in both shipped topologies
scenarios.when: results are compared
scenarios.then: semantics authorization and byte contracts match and unsupported topologies cannot silently serve

scenarios.title: Library SDK and MCP remain independent
scenarios.given: a minimal library SDK or MCP installation has no gateway extras or credentials
scenarios.when: its existing regression suite executes
scenarios.then: imports and behavior remain unchanged and no gateway process or login is launched

scenarios.title: No hidden tool execution in an API request
scenarios.given: a user request includes tool definitions but no authorized server-side execution capability
scenarios.when: native and translated responses return tool calls
scenarios.then: the gateway returns them to the client and executes no shell file write network tool or MCP call

scenarios.title: Gate A binds the exact source SHA
scenarios.given: a candidate has a pinned source SHA and complete required test evidence
scenarios.when: any source change is made after qualification
scenarios.then: the earlier Gate A result cannot qualify the changed source

scenarios.title: Gate B installs the retained release bytes
scenarios.given: wheel container or binary artifacts have recorded digests
scenarios.when: a clean supported environment installs those exact artifacts and runs its matrix
scenarios.then: evidence records the same digests and source provenance without rebuilding substitutes

scenarios.title: Unsafe runtime overrides remove qualification
scenarios.given: a release candidate runs with an unsafe auth transport or feature-rollout override
scenarios.when: qualification status is evaluated
scenarios.then: the instance is marked ineligible and cannot be promoted as standard-ready

scenarios.title: Missing evidence cannot be hidden by a green subset
scenarios.given: a required OS auth source protocol SDK or artifact cell is skipped or unavailable
scenarios.when: release admission evaluates the manifest
scenarios.then: the capability remains unqualified and promotion is blocked or its advertised scope is explicitly reduced

scenarios.title: Rollback preserves existing user state
scenarios.given: the gateway feature is disabled or the previous qualified artifact restored
scenarios.when: legacy wrappers start using the retained supported configuration
scenarios.then: no native credential cache or unrelated configuration has been migrated irreversibly

scenarios.title: Credential discovery is not admission
scenarios.given: a local native auth file exists for a provider without approved gateway eligibility
scenarios.when: metadata discovery and then generation are requested
scenarios.then: metadata may report a candidate but generation is unavailable and the secret is not imported

scenarios.title: Restricted subscription credentials are not generic API keys
scenarios.given: a Claude subscription credential is available to an ordinary native client
scenarios.when: the gateway is configured to broker it for arbitrary API clients
scenarios.then: admission rejects the generic broker path while leaving the separate native-client workflow untouched

scenarios.title: Agent SDK execution is not called transparent inference
scenarios.given: an approved native integration exposes an agent runtime with planning or built-in tools
scenarios.when: the operator asks to expose it as a strict native inference route
scenarios.then: the gateway rejects that claim and requires a distinct explicitly described execution capability

scenarios.title: Unverified providers are not advertised as supported
scenarios.given: provider names with no established primary auth and protocol contract are present in discovery notes
scenarios.when: the public model and capability catalog is built
scenarios.then: no routes are advertised until admission protocol refresh and E2E evidence are supplied

scenarios.title: No impersonation or content obfuscation is added
scenarios.given: a provider adapter would require changing user agents to impersonate a native client or hiding proxy-related prompt text
scenarios.when: the integration is reviewed and its output fixtures run
scenarios.then: the adapter remains unqualified rather than cloaking the application or altering prompts

scenarios.title: Admitted browser onboarding stores only the approved account
scenarios.given: an approved provider adapter and explicit operator login transaction exist
scenarios.when: browser authorization finishes with the expected account issuer scopes and PKCE exchange
scenarios.then: one scoped Headroom account reference is stored and the callback listener closes

scenarios.title: PKCE and state mismatch do not produce a credential
scenarios.given: a browser login transaction has a fresh state and S256 challenge
scenarios.when: a mismatched state verifier or downgraded challenge is supplied
scenarios.then: the transaction fails without publishing a credential or changing caller grants

scenarios.title: Redirect validation is exact within the admitted native flow
scenarios.given: a provider flow specifies an allowed callback origin path and loopback port rule
scenarios.when: a lookalike host altered path userinfo URL or external redirect is offered
scenarios.then: the flow rejects it before exposing an authorization code or token

scenarios.title: Authorization callback replay is one time only
scenarios.given: a login transaction has already consumed its successful callback
scenarios.when: the same code and state arrive again
scenarios.then: no second token exchange account creation or credential overwrite occurs

scenarios.title: Device login respects polling and terminal outcomes
scenarios.given: an admitted device grant returns pending slowdown denial and expiry fixture responses
scenarios.when: the login driver polls and then receives cancellation or a terminal outcome
scenarios.then: the documented interval and slowdown apply and all polling stops on cancellation denial expiry or success

scenarios.title: Discovery does not silently become account import
scenarios.given: metadata discovery finds an approved reusable native login source
scenarios.when: the operator has not consented to import or activate that account
scenarios.then: no reusable secret is read copied refreshed or granted to API callers

scenarios.title: An unexpected account cannot replace the selected one
scenarios.given: the operator constrained login to an organization or account
scenarios.when: the callback proves a different account or tenant
scenarios.then: the broker declines activation and leaves the existing account and grants unchanged

scenarios.title: Cancelled browser login leaves no active credential
scenarios.given: a browser login is pending with a temporary callback listener
scenarios.when: the operator cancels or the transaction deadline expires
scenarios.then: the listener closes secrets and transient state are discarded and no account becomes available

scenarios.title: Occupied callback ports do not cause process takeover
scenarios.given: another process owns a proposed callback port
scenarios.when: the native login driver attempts startup
scenarios.then: it chooses a separately permitted available port or fails without reusing or killing the other process

scenarios.title: A client registration cannot impersonate an unadmitted application
scenarios.given: a native adapter lacks approval for the registered client and requested endpoint audience
scenarios.when: configuration supplies another application client identifier or demands broader scopes
scenarios.then: admission fails before login and no identifying-header disguise is used
